title: Science elective
description: A natural science course for engineering students, such as general chemistry, cell and molecular biology, or calculus-based physics, chosen from an approved list.
notes: NYU: three of CM-UY 1003, CM-UY 1013, BMS-UY 1003, PH-UY 1013, PH-UY 2023, PH-UY 2033 (9-12 credits).

title: Humanities and social sciences elective
description: A general education course in the humanities or social sciences, chosen from the college's approved list.
notes: NYU: four HUSS courses; one must be an ethics course.

title: Computer science elective
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen by the student from the department's electives.

title: Free elective
description: A free elective chosen by the student.
